# Denmark Crop Fields (Marker)

Denmark field boundaries (2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Danish Agricultural Agency. License: CC0-1.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/dk/latest/dk.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/dk/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:25832; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: collection, crop:name, geometry, hcat:name, metrics:area, hcat:name_en, crop:code, id, hcat:code, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/dk/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/dk/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/dk/collection.json
